settings.title: App settings
settings.subtitle: The parent & student app: switch it on, choose what it shows, and share its address with families.
settings.signInHint: Families sign in with the mobile number on the student’s record and a code by SMS (your SMS account in Integrations, or the platform’s). Only their own children are shown, and only finished things: published results, issued certificates, valid receipts.
settings.offNote: The app is switched off — families who open this address see “not available”.
